name: Noty
author: FranjeGueje
description: Show Steam notifications from your own scripts and from programs like Comet: POST JSON to a local web service.

settings.label: Active
settings.hint: Turns the web service on or off. It listens on 127.0.0.1 only: programs on this machine can send notifications, nothing else on the network can.

settings.label: Port
settings.hint: Where the service listens: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/notify. Turn the service off to change it.

settings.label: Do not disturb
settings.hint: Requests are still received and answered, but nothing is shown on Steam. The test button still works.

items.label: General — /notify
items.hint: Noty's own format: {"title", "body", "icon", "sound"}. Off: requests are answered, but nothing is shown.

items.label: Comet — /cometa
items.hint: Achievements sent by Comet itself (its custom_event setting). Off: requests are answered, but nothing is shown.

items.label: Comet (fallback by db) — /cometa/db
items.hint: Achievements unlocked in GOG games run through Comet. Off: requests are answered, but nothing is shown.
